_doc: T-135: one more companion per map, like Jakub (MapCompanion, gravelight/world/map_companion.gd). Each waits somewhere on its map, calls out when a survivor is near, and joins on a talk: GIVE A GUN (the one in your hands) or COME AS YOU ARE (its melee). With you it fights as a squad bot (brain options), can be revived, bleeds out like Jakub (out cold for the match) and brings a small gift at the start of each round while it stands within gift_range_m of the one it follows. maps: map id prefixes it appears on; find_on: where it waits to be found (else it only arrives with you, if carry_flag is set from an earlier act). spot: a rough point snapped to the navmesh at load. pid: its own player id (Jakub is 9). Online (T-138) it is simulated on the host and a puppet on every client (CompanionNet), like Jakub.

trudi.name: Trudi Hanke
trudi.title: TRUDI HANKE
trudi.speaker: TRU
trudi.spot_note: the stable, behind the hay: she ran out into the snow in round 1 and hid here
trudi.ask: "I can carry a gun if you can spare one. Or I come with the bread knife. Your choice."
trudi.unarmed: she follows you with the bread knife

ammer.name: Fw. August "Gustl" Ammer
ammer.title: AUGUST "GUSTL" AMMER
ammer.speaker: AMM
ammer.spot_note: the barracks stores: the quartermaster who fed the labourers, locked in by his own sergeant
ammer.bio: The garrison's quartermaster, 50s, a Bavarian NCO with no insignia left on him. He kept the stores' books honest and fed the labour gangs out of them for two winters; his own sergeant locked him in when the stores were counted short. He still sells from the shelves, by the book.

trade.said: The stores are open. Fifteen hundred, and the book balances. I choose what comes off the shelf.

ammer.ask: "Give me a rifle and I will earn it. Or I come with what I have. I counted every loaf in this place, I can count zombies."
ammer.unarmed: he follows you with his knife

petersen.name: Hinnerk Petersen
petersen.title: HINNERK PETERSEN
petersen.speaker: PET
petersen.spot_note: UPDATE 10 (T-153): his scene: trapped on the signal tower stair since the Erwachen, the flood below him and the dead on the catwalks; hand him a gun and he fights from the signal room; in Letzte Fahrt he takes U-1047's wheel (UboatSail): the old harbour pilot who would not take the cargo ship out
petersen.ask: "Forty years I took ships through this harbour. I will take you through it. With a gun, if you have one to spare."
petersen.unarmed: he follows you with his boat hook knife

scene._doc: UPDATE 10 section 9 (T-170): his stair scene while he waits (design section 6): the first flood (GLBus signal) or the first survivor within near_m plays his trapped line once (the speaker's category, positional at him) instead of the generic call; the card's said text is the scene's while he is still on the stair.
scene.said: He is wedged on the tower stair above the water line, a boat hook in his fist, the dead on the catwalks below him. "The stair's the only dry thing left. Give me something that shoots and I'll hold the tower."

jette.name: Henriette "Jette" Maurer
jette.title: JETTE MAURER
jette.speaker: JET
jette.spot_note: the station, the yardmaster's hut: the wind-tunnel technician who refused to fly their glider
jette.ask: "I know every hangar and every fence on this field. Give me a gun and I will show you the way out. Or I come without one."
jette.unarmed: she follows you with a spanner
jette.stays_note: with you through Act III; she stays behind at Groom Lake (the rocket seats four)
